backup.production_rule: s116 (Lloyd 2026-11-15): staff_guest_card_v1 gains one key, id_photo_name: btrim(name) of the guest_companions row whose id_photo_path is the guest primary ID photo (the row id_face_box is read from), under the same gate as id_photo_path (guest given and staff_may_see_guest_id_v1), else null. It reaches the Staff app through staff_home_v1 existing merge of staff_guest_card_v1 (no change there). Every other key and line of the s115 body is unchanged. The orchestrator re-stamps restore_point and verified_at on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase backfill is the house label for a function body; no table, column, row, trigger or other function changes. One function body is replaced (guarded by the md5 of the live s115 body, 4405ec514a941053bd25160936fc0926) and its grants are restated (service_role only). Expected live effect: the card of a guest whose only ID photo is a companion now carries that companion name; older readers ignore the extra key.

forward_verification.name: md5_staff_guest_card_v1
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'b45a48e1e5997e429098d1061a2d538c' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: card_has_id_photo_name_same_gate
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%''id_photo_name'', case when p_guest_id is not null and public.staff_may_see_guest_id_v1(p_property_id)%' and prosrc like '%nullif(btrim(c.name), '''')%' and prosrc like '%c.id_photo_path = public.staff_primary_id_path_v1(p_guest_id)%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: card_keeps_s115_and_s97_parts
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%Turnover report: %' and prosrc like '%turnover_issue_text_v1%' and prosrc like '%''id_face_box''%' and prosrc like '%''id_photo_path''%' and prosrc like '%''notable''%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: card_grants_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: card_still_definer_stable_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select prosecdef and provolatile = 's' and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: card_signature_and_return_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_function_identity_arguments(oid) = 'p_property_id uuid, p_guest_id uuid, p_checkin date' and prorettype = 'jsonb'::regtype and (select count(*) from pg_proc where proname = 'staff_guest_card_v1' and pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace) = 1 from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date)'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: Always: the script puts the s115 body back exactly (md5 guard on the s116 body). No data is touched, so nothing is lost.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261115_s116_guest_photo_name.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; then md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) of public.staff_guest_card_v1(uuid,uuid,date) must be 4405ec514a941053bd25160936fc0926.

feature_flags.name: no_flag
feature_flags.required_state: None. The rollback script is the switch. The Staff app (lane A, 3.4.31) reads id_photo_name and shows nothing new while it is null or absent.
